body.name: Four symbolic null families
body.construction: \(\mathcal F_3\) is the set of maps of the following four disjoint forms, where \(a,b,c\) are distinct elements of \(U\): (i) \(g(z)=\varnothing\); (ii) for \(s\in\{\varnothing,\{b\},\{c\}\}\), choose \(\{a\}\) whenever \(a\in z\), otherwise choose \(s\) whenever \(s\ne\varnothing\) and \(s\subseteq z\), and otherwise choose \(\varnothing\); (iii) for an unordered pair \(\{a,b\}\) and \((\rho_a,\rho_b)\in\{0,1\}^2\), choose \(\{a,b\}\) when \(\{a,b\}\subseteq z\), otherwise choose \(\{a\}\) if \(a\in z\) and \(\rho_a=1\), otherwise choose \(\{b\}\) if \(b\in z\) and \(\rho_b=1\), and otherwise choose \(\varnothing\); (iv) for an unordered pair \(\{a,b\}\) with remaining factor \(c\), either choose by the priority \(\{a,b\}\succ\{b\}\succ\{c\}\succ\varnothing\) with \(\{a\}\) below \(\varnothing\), or symmetrically by \(\{a,b\}\succ\{a\}\succ\{c\}\succ\varnothing\) with \(\{b\}\) below \(\varnothing\), placing every unlisted bundle below \(\varnothing\).
